firstPlayerRule: Choose the player who last saw rats in a bathtub, or choose the youngest player.
clarifications: That player places the first Action card; play then proceeds counterclockwise.

sources.title: Tales & Games: The Pied Piper — English rulebook

internalEvidence: Rendered page 1 gives both suggested starting choices. Page 2 gives the opening Action card and counterclockwise direction.
